article.headline: Germán Berterame strikes early as Inter Miami shuts out New York City
article.summary: Inter Miami secured a 2-0 victory over New York City FC on Wednesday after an opening goal from Germán Berterame.
article.body:
The breakthrough arrived in the 20th minute when a sequence of precise passes by the Herons dismantled the New York City backline. Luis Suárez swept the ball across the goal face to find Germán Berterame, who delivered a clinical tap to put the home side in front. Despite the loss, New York City FC demonstrated crisp passing and controlled possession for the opening 20 minutes, showcasing flashes of intelligent movement that stood in stark contrast to their recent run of results. 

This result highlights the persistent offensive struggles facing the Bronx side throughout the 2026 season. While New York City FC maintained structural integrity and controlled the ball for stretches, they remained unable to convert their momentum into goals against Dayne St. Clair. The match represents the final outing of a three-game road trip for the visitors, who have found points increasingly difficult to secure as the season progresses.

According to LiveScore, the visitors entered the match following a defeat to Chicago Fire FC, leaving the team appearing mentally drained. While coach Pascal Jansen opted to start Alonso Martínez for the second consecutive match, the team's inability to find the back of the net proved decisive. Even as the match progressed and Miami increased their time on the ball, the defensive resolve of the home side ensured that New York City FC finished the encounter without a goal. 

As the 2026 campaign continues, the pressure remains on the New York City attack to find the clinical finishing required to convert possession into points. The loss reinforces the current narrative for the squad, where consistent tactical efforts have repeatedly failed to yield the necessary results on the scoreboard.

news.title: Iraq will not become a launchpad for attacks on Saudi Arabia, vows prime minister
HRH the Crown Prince, Iraqi Prime Minister Hold Talks in Riyadh; Al-Zaidi Affirms Rejection of Attacks on Saudi Arabia
news.og_title: HRH the Crown Prince, Iraqi Prime Minister Hold Talks in Riyadh; Al-Zaidi Affirms Rejection of Attacks on Saudi Arabia
news.og_desc:
Riyadh, October 14, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, received at Al-Yamamah Palace in Riyadh on Wednesday Prime Minister of the Republic of Iraq Ali Falih Al-Zaidi, who expressed the Iraqi government's strong condemnation and denunciation of the attack targeting King Khalid International Airport and the attacks on civilian and vital facilities in the Kingdom, describing them as a threat to regional security and stability.
    Al-Zaidi affirmed his government's firm stance against allowing Iraqi territory to be used as a launchpad for any aggression or acts affecting the security of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and other countries in the region, and its commitment to the principles of good neighborliness and respect for the sovereignty of the Kingdom and brotherly nations.
    The two sides discussed regional developments and coordination of efforts to enhance the region's security and stability.
    They also reviewed Saudi-Iraqi relations, with HRH the Crown Prince emphasizing the Kingdom's keenness to strengthen cooperation between the two countries in various fields, particularly security coordination.
    -- SPA
18:05 Local Time 15:05 GMT

news.title: Saudi Crown Prince Meets with Iraqi Prime Minister in Riyadh
news.og_title: Saudi Crown Prince Meets with Iraqi Prime Minister in Riyadh
news.og_desc: Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman met with Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi on Wednesday following his arrival in Riyadh for a visit to the Kingdom. During the meeting, the two leaders discussed regional developments and coordinated efforts to strengthen security and stability in the region. They also reviewed Saudi-Iraqi relations and ways to enhance cooperation across various fields, particularly security coordination between the two countries to address potential regional security challenges.
